name: env-select-omitted-multiple-envs
description: Omitting --env with several declared environments applies none, falling back to CLI flags.
yaml:
project: Demo
apps:
  - id: main
    platform: android
    appId: com.example.app
  - id: alt
    platform: ios
    appId: com.example.alt
environments:
  staging:
    app: main
  prod:
    app: alt
